faq.q: Which schools are near Blu Living, by name and address?
faq.a: Morgan Elementary at 3366 156a St and Grandview Heights Secondary at 16987 25 Ave, Surrey, both confirmed in the BC Ministry K-12 file; Southridge School (independent) is at 2656 160 St (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01)

faq.q: How large are Blu Living homes?
faq.a: The live page describes four- and five-bedroom townhomes beside detached strata homes, together ranging from about 2,800 to 3,300 sq ft — site copy; confirm the exact size of a specific unit

faq.q: What should a buyer review before buying at Blu Living?
faq.a: The Form B information certificate, the strata bylaws and rules, the last two years of minutes and the depreciation report, plus what the monthly fees cover

faq.q: Are townhomes in Blu Living freehold or strata?
faq.a: Most are strata, either a building strata or a bare-land strata, with monthly fees and bylaws. Some are freehold row homes with no strata. The title search tells you which, and it decides which costs and rules apply.

faq.q: What should I check on a townhome in Blu Living?
faq.a: Read the Form B, the bylaws, the strata minutes and the depreciation report, and ask about exterior repairs, pet and rental rules and who looks after the fences, roofs and yards.
